# Generate new CR descriptions and mix generated messages with supplied files.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-11-06T18:00:00Z'

cd repo
git init
git add .shamhub
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Initial commit'
shamhub-setup
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
shamhub register alice
git push origin main
env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login

git add one.txt
gs branch create feature1 -m 'Default title one' -m 'Default body one'
git add two.txt
gs branch create feature2 -m 'Default title two' -m 'Default body two'
git add three.txt
gs branch create feature3 -m 'Default title three'
git config spice.message.fill.command mock-message
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RESPONSE=$WORK/message.txt
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RECORD=$WORK/invocation

# The command sees the normal draft but may replace it with an empty body.
gs --no-prompt downstack submit --branch feature1 --fill --no-draft
stderr 'Created #1'
cmp $WORK/invocation/draft $WORK/golden/draft.txt
git config spice.message.fill true
! gs --no-prompt stack submit --no-fill --no-draft
stderr 'prompt for commit information'
git config spice.message.fill false
gs --no-prompt stack submit -c --no-draft --message-file feature2:$WORK/message.md
stderr 'Created #2'
stderr 'Created #3'
git config spice.message.fill true

# Existing descriptions are untouched and do not invoke the command.
env MOCK_MESSAGE_EXIT=8
gs --no-prompt stack submit --fill --no-draft
shamhub dump changes
cmpenvJSON stdout $WORK/golden/changes.json

# Supplied messages bypass the command for a single new CR too.
gs branch create supplied --no-commit
git add supplied.txt
gs commit create -m Supplied
env MOCK_MESSAGE_EXIT=8
gs --no-prompt branch submit --fill --no-draft --title 'Explicit title' --body 'Explicit body'
stderr 'Created #4'

-- repo/one.txt --
one
-- repo/two.txt --
two
-- repo/three.txt --
three
-- repo/supplied.txt --
supplied
-- repo/.shamhub/CHANGE_TEMPLATE.md --
Default template body
-- message.txt --
Generated {{.Subject}}
-- message.md --
Supplied title

Supplied body.
-- golden/draft.txt --
Default title one

Default body one

Default template body
-- golden/changes.json --
